darkness-activated-tiles.RangeHint: You may specify a range of darkness levels during which this tile will be visible. A range of 0 to 1 leaves the tile always visible.
darkness-activated-tiles.FadeDurationHin: How long this tile takes to fade in and out as it activates and deactivates. Leave blank to use the world defaults, or set a duration to 0 to switch instantly.
darkness-activated-tiles.fadeInHint: How long a tile takes to fade in when the darkness level enters its activation range, in milliseconds. Set to 0 to switch instantly. Individual tiles can override this.
darkness-activated-tiles.fadeOutHint: How long a tile takes to fade out when the darkness level leaves its activation range, in milliseconds. Set to 0 to switch instantly. Individual tiles can override this.
